newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-ENQVIST POWERS PAST BRUGUERA TO JOIN FINAL 16.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ENQVIST POWERS PAST BRUGUERA TO JOIN FINAL 16.

text.p: Seventh seed Thomas Enqvist powered into the fourth round of the Australian Open with a straight sets win over former French Open champion Sergi Bruguera.
Swede Enqvist, who achieved his best result in a grand slam by reaching the quarter-finals in Melbourne last year, swept past the Spaniard 7-6 (10-8) 7-5 6-2 in just over two hours on centre court.
Bruguera, a clay court specialist who won at Roland Garros in 1993 and 1994, put up a stern fight but gradually faded after taking Enqvist to a tie-break in the first set.
Enqvist, ranked nine in the world, will next meet ninth seed Marcelo Rios of Chile to vie for a quarter-final berth.
